title: Rudra Tarpaulin B2B Website & Admin Panel
description: Client project: SEO-focused B2B catalog site for a Gujarat tarpaulin manufacturer, with a custom admin panel for products, inquiries, content and image uploads.
about: Rudra Enterprise (Rudra Tarpaulin) manufactures HDPE and LDPE tarpaulins, pond liners, truck covers and Silpaulin sheets in Dhanot, Gujarat, and sells in bulk across India. I built their public website and a custom admin panel so the team can run the catalog and handle leads without a developer. The public site is built for search, with keyword-focused titles and descriptions and clear calls to action for WhatsApp and phone inquiries.
responsibilities: Built the public product catalog and company site with Next.js, deployed on Vercel.
Designed a custom admin panel to add, edit and remove products, including specs like GSM and sizes.
Built an inquiry inbox so the client can review quote requests and leads from the site in one place.
Added content editing and image uploads so the team updates banners, text and product photos themselves.
Created Next.js API routes backed by MongoDB for products, inquiries and site content.
Set up SEO metadata for B2B search terms like HDPE tarpaulin manufacturer and wholesale supplier.

title: Honeyvan D2C E-Commerce Platform
description: Direct-to-consumer organic raw honey store featuring automated inventory tracking, localized checkout, and direct Telegram support notifications.
about: Honeyvan is a farm-direct e-commerce website that sells raw organic honey. Features include automated inventory tracking, farm-to-jar sliders, seamless mobile checkout, and live WhatsApp/Telegram notifications for orders and customer service queries.
responsibilities: Developed a responsive front-end storefront with custom animations and interactive product galleries.
Built an automated Telegram notification bot that instantly pushes checkout inquiries and customer support chats to the administrator's dashboard.
Integrated secure mobile checkout workflows and streamlined localized delivery options.

title: StrangerConnect Video Matching App
description: Real-time anonymous video chat platform with active queue matchmaking, low-latency WebRTC streams, and token-based security.
about: StrangerConnect is a real-time chat platform that anonymously connects random users over video and text streams. Includes security-first authentication, multi-level active queue matchmaking, and optimized grid layouts.
responsibilities: Designed and implemented the front-end user matching state machine using React hooks and Socket.io events.
Integrated WebRTC peer connections with fallback STUN/TURN configurations for high-reliability video chat.
Implemented JWT refresh token authentication and role-based permissions to ensure platform safety.

title: KMT Healthcare Platform
description: React + Next.js patient monitoring portal with multilingual dashboards, theming, and clinic-ready workflows.
about: Core web experience for Kali Med Tech that brings ECG data, device status, and analytics to hospital ops teams with responsive layouts and localization.
responsibilities: Implemented role-based dashboards with configurable themes, multilingual copy, and responsive cards.
Integrated REST APIs for ECG uploads, AI-assisted insights, and device provisioning workflows.
Collaborated across backend and QA pods to ensure clean data contracts and reliable releases.

title: OOM ECG Analyzer Platform
description: Clinic interface for ECG uploads, AI analysis, and live review queues powered by React and WebSocket.
about: Delivers seamless ECG ingestion with mobile-first views, progress indicators, and alerts for cardiology teams.
responsibilities: Built upload flows with optimistic UI, chunked transfers, and queued notifications.
Streamed AI processing states over WebSockets for real-time clinician feedback.
Ensured accessibility and consistency across tablet, desktop, and kiosk touchpoints.

title: Quality Management System (QMS)
description: Role-based dashboards that coordinate QA, support, and hardware teams with localization and theming.
about: A modular interface that digitizes CAPA tracking, multilingual comms, and compliance reporting for Kali Med Tech teams.
responsibilities: Designed UX flows for admins, QA, and support roles with granular permissions.
Implemented theme and locale switching plus charting for quality indicators.
Added Jest + React Testing Library coverage for mission-critical modules.

title: BLE & UART Monitoring Apps
description: Electron + React desktop tools streaming multiple ECG devices with Chart.js visualizations.
about: Cross-platform monitoring suite capturing device telemetry over BLE and UART, surfacing it to clinicians with real-time graphs.
responsibilities: Handled concurrent BLE connections with resilience for OR environments.
Crafted Chart.js overlays for arrhythmia, signal strength, and lead health.
Synchronized data back to cloud services via secure WebSocket channels.

title: Inventory & Device Tracking Suite
description: Inventory and allocation workflows keeping ECG devices, accessories, and licenses in sync across clinics.
about: Extends the KMT platform with asset lifecycle management, allocation queues, and alerting for device maintenance windows.
responsibilities: Modeled device hierarchies, allocation states, and order workflows inside a reusable component system.
Built status, warranty, and calibration views with filterable, exportable tables.
Automated notifications for returns, servicing, and deployment readiness.
